title: Doppler secret custody
principles: Trace each value to a real consumer before Doppler admission.
Use fixed root wrappers and credential-neutral internal commands.
Give each hosted config one read-only, config-scoped, expiring token.
Keep local, CI, Preview, Production, provider and public claims separate.
Remove only exact unused GitHub duplicates after merged-path proof; never revoke an underlying credential still consumed through Doppler.

tasks.title: Prove the consumer inventory and Doppler layout
tasks.description: Trace current source, workflow, Vercel, Alchemy, GitHub and secret-custody metadata, then admit dev, stg and prd plus any later bounded config proved by a real consumer.
implementationNotes: Verified the exact repository, Personal Doppler workplace, GitHub Environments, Personal Vercel team/projects, mixed current Git-link metadata, R2 state owner and current workflow consumers without reading secret values.
Confirmed Personal Developer plan does not expose service accounts or OIDC identities, so hosted configs use expiring config-scoped service tokens.

The later approved state-only repair proved one additional temporary local consumer. Its locked root config held only the eight direct inputs required by that operation, inherited nothing and had no service token; the later hard cutover removed it.
mandatoryVerification: Every inventory row names source owner, consumer, environment, classification, desired config and migration state.
No Vercel runtime value or Alchemy deployment ownership is moved into Doppler.
The synthetic Executor endpoint and key are classified as non-secret local verification inputs.
completionCriteria: Every config is supported by a real consumer; dev_personal remains empty and no dummy value is added.
Naming and least-privilege decisions are explicit.

tasks.title: Implement bounded repository and provider custody
tasks.description: Add root/internal command splits, pinned output-only workflow fetches, executable contract tests, Doppler metadata, and exact GitHub Environment tokens without deleting legacy values.
implementationNotes: Created Personal Doppler root configs dev, stg and prd; loaded only the inventoried key sets and left the automatic empty dev_personal branch config without dummy values.
Stored one 30-day read-only config token in each exact GitHub Environment. The 15-minute stg migration token is no longer stored in GitHub and will expire without manual revocation.
Final-source Preview run 32676125884 proved fetch, custody materialisation, manifest digest and sanitised receipt; native Alchemy provider readback remained inconclusive.
mandatoryVerification: Workflow tests reject a changed action pin, direct removed-secret reference, missing named output, broad injection, root wrapper use in GitHub and fork credential exposure.
Knip accepts the external Doppler binary and no other lint or boundary rule is weakened.
Doppler readback reports only project/config/key names and token scope/expiry metadata; GitHub readback reports only secret names.
Existing Effect Schemas, redacted Config values, exact project routing, provider Layers, replay and receipt contracts remain unchanged.
completionCriteria: Repository checks pass on the exact source.
Doppler and GitHub metadata match the consumer-backed hosted layout; the temporary local repair config remained separate until hard cutover.
No legacy provider secret or variable is deleted or revoked.

tasks.title: Open the PR and separate hosted proof from non-claims
tasks.description: Push the focused branch, open a PR to main, wait for checks, fix change-caused failures and record exact remaining cleanup.
implementationNotes: Opened PR #7 against main and retained the no-merge, no-deploy and no-cleanup boundaries.
Hosted CI run 32676441398 passed on exact head bb74bd25867f1a840a1c359cde9187270611c416.
Preview run 32676441344 proved Doppler fetch/custody and then failed closed on the recorded inconclusive native Alchemy readback; this is not a Production or public-behaviour claim.
mandatoryVerification: Hosted CI is bound to the exact PR head SHA.
Same-repository Preview drift proves only the stg fetch and report path when it runs successfully.
No Production workflow, deployment, promotion, public journey, secret deletion or token revocation is triggered.
A fresh ownership/call-graph, implementation-quality and verification-coverage review finds no unresolved change-caused defect.
completionCriteria: The PR URL and final check state are recorded.
Remaining post-merge proof and cleanup need explicit approval and exact target readback.

tasks.title: Re-admit exact Preview metadata, merge, prove Production and clean unused GitHub duplicates
tasks.description: Use Cooper's 2026-08-24 continuation approval to combine PR #6's provider corrections with PR #7, refresh only the changed accepted Preview metadata from repeated read-only evidence, require exact-head checks, merge, observe the automatic Production result, then delete only the nine proved-unused GitHub duplicates.
implementationNotes: PR #6's exact-project Vercel, R2, Marketplace and drift-classification corrections are integrated into PR #7 while the Doppler workflow hand-off remains authoritative.
Eight live Preview Vercel environment rows, four per project, were mapped from the fail-closed receipt. Their metadata changed after the accepted manifest; their values remain unclaimed.

The personal 1Password CLI session timed out twice, so no Tilt account or alternate credential source was used. The continuation instead narrows inventory to the already-proved exact-project credentials held in bundjil/stg.

Two matching reads produced inventory digest 64ec77630806b6f61dba689c25c5068b8b0254f5a4062854c320f4f4b2e81813 with zero provider writes. The first f0a02c0f1bae439ae1a5019c9a7a2f8c71d58f945a508c25ab391b0686c273c3 transport preserved 155 resources plus all managed references while refreshing only the exact eight approved identities.

The Alchemy memory-provider contract proves that externally changed ObservedUnknown type/revision metadata refreshes state with zero provider writes and then plans no-op. Live plan inspection separately proved seven state updates plus one provider-revision-only no-op across the eight approved identities.

The state-only repair command used a distinct fixed temporary consumer, denied provider mutation services, kept all eight approved identities in scope, accepted only seven exact state updates plus 148 no-ops, applied the same in-memory plan and required a 155-no-op follow-up.

The locked root repair config had exactly eight direct inputs, no inherited values and no service token. The live state-only operation applied seven updates and its immediate and independent follow-up plans each contained 155 no-ops. Its receipt names base SHA 67b2d95c, but the operation ran from an uncommitted repair tree, so this proves observed Alchemy state convergence rather than exact-source execution. The later hard cutover removed the temporary consumer and config.

CI run 33353598799 passed exact PR head a28ed2b919f821dc8adb7ea634cf2b12fc395344. Preview run 33353598789 fetched the refreshed manifest, produced 155 desired no-ops and zero writes, and safely remained inconclusive only on the provider-revision-only identity.

A fresh exact-head two-read inventory matched digest 64ec77630806b6f61dba689c25c5068b8b0254f5a4062854c320f4f4b2e81813. Timestamp-only candidate 2f3118ce3193ff12ec14a2d4041ec2aaf305453762643f4ab5fa3df92aa28e0f received exact Doppler readback but was superseded before push because its identity omitted other admitted metadata. Version 3 candidate bb731f680e64422d198ed6fa88997a23dbf4f99f55ba743d36d10c954dff76f5 binds the full sorted admitted metadata plus provider timestamps, so metadata-only candidate changes cannot share an identity. Its clean local report passed with zero blocking, zero inconclusive and zero writes. Exact bundjil/stg readback matched its bytes, digest, 155 resources and eight timestamps.

CI run 33357705409 and Preview run 33357705406 passed exact head edc5e9d0269dea81d39eb38b734a5b233884cd2e. Preview used version 3 digest bb731f680e64422d198ed6fa88997a23dbf4f99f55ba743d36d10c954dff76f5 and matched the local result: 63 accepted, 92 report-only, zero blocking, zero inconclusive, 155 no-ops and zero provider writes.
A clean local report against the corrected candidate passed with 155 desired no-ops, 63 accepted rows, 92 report-only rows, zero blocking rows, zero inconclusive rows and zero provider writes.

Final CI run 33358065293 and Preview run 33358065300 passed exact PR head c418d2e8925fb389cdbabe6fbb059b4fae7e3169. PR #7 merged as 413d39a072f31ef64af0502b38a6a4f46786f53f and main CI run 33358238289 passed.

Automatic Production run 33358460243 returned promoted for the exact merge SHA with rollback ready. Independent Vercel readback matched both READY stable targets, the agent callback, the live proxy health Schema and project-token isolation.

The approved cleanup removed only the five unused GitHub secret duplicates and four unused GitHub variable duplicates. Name-only readback found DOPPLER_TOKEN in both exact Environments and only BUNDJIL_PRODUCTION_AGENT_CALLBACK_ALIAS as the retained Production variable. Doppler key names and read-only token scope/expiry metadata remained current; no provider credential was revoked.
mandatoryVerification: Two consecutive exact-project read-only inventories encode the same canonical provider manifest with providerWrites zero.
The refreshed accepted manifest is Schema-encoded, digest-bound, compressed in memory and installed in bundjil/stg without logging a value.
Exact-head CI and Preview drift pass before merge; the automatic Production run is tied to the merged main SHA.
GitHub cleanup deletes only the five unused secret names and four unused variable names in the exact two Environments, then name-only readback proves DOPPLER_TOKEN remains.
No underlying Vercel credential is revoked, no permission is widened and no public behaviour is claimed without a direct journey.
completionCriteria: PR #7 is merged after exact-head green checks.
Automatic Production and provider readbacks are recorded separately.
The exact unused GitHub duplicates are absent and Doppler metadata remains current.
All local and hosted checks required by the repository pass on their recorded source identities.

tasks.title: Retire the temporary repair path and complete the Doppler hard cutover
tasks.description: Use Cooper's 2026-08-31 approval to remove the one-off state-repair source and exact temporary Doppler config, correct every current owner, merge only after exact-head proof, and delete only the merged Doppler branches.
implementationNotes: Removed the friendly and internal state-repair commands, one-off script, policy Schema, state validation module, exact-project-only repair Layer export and focused tests.
Kept the credential-neutral adoption metadata refresh because it is read-only, has no temporary config and remains a valid recovery policy.
Updated the current inventory, runbook, authority and automation owners so none offers the completed state write as a reusable operation or rollback through deleted GitHub duplicates.
Exact-head CI 33370139881 and read-only Preview run 33370139899 passed head cdd492b075c311bbc306059f6289a624efefae1f with 155 no-ops and zero provider writes.

The temporary repair environment/root config had no service token or remaining consumer and was deleted through Doppler's supported environment operation. Name-only readback found only dev, stg and prd plus the empty dev_personal branch config. This did not rotate or revoke the active provider credentials still consumed through bundjil/stg.
The active dev, stg and prd configs remain consumer-backed. The automatically created dev_personal config remains empty without dummy values.
mandatoryVerification: Focused package checks, documentation and authority checks, Knip and full verification pass on exact source.
Exact-head CI and Preview pass before merge; exact-main CI and automatic Production are reported separately after merge.
Name-only Doppler readback proves the temporary config absent while dev, stg and prd remain.
GitHub name-only readback retains only the two active Doppler bootstrap tokens and the Production callback alias.
No active provider credential is revoked, rotated or widened, and no public behaviour is claimed.
completionCriteria: No current command, package export, runbook or current authority owner references the retired repair path.
The temporary Doppler config and merged Doppler branches are absent by exact readback.
Final main and hosted proof are tied to their exact source SHA.
